answer: Your ex still has to sign, the same as any co-owner on the title. They can come to the appointment with their photo ID, or sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically with no notary. In Georgia, though, it must be notarized. The exception is if your divorce decree awards the car to you. Then bring a certified copy of the decree, and your ex doesn't need to sign. For your name, bring the document that shows the change, such as your divorce decree or a court order, and sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
